prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Selection Screen: Add a dedicated pet personality selection screen into the adoption flow before sign-in to let users choose behavioral traits for their pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_personality_select", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "pick_friend": {"show_step_counter": true}}
1: [finish, redesign] Interactive Companion Mode Selector on Home Welcome: Redesign the home welcome screen by replacing the static intro with interactive companion mode choice cards (e.g. Quiet, Playful).
   config: {"home_intro": {"replace": {"home_welcome": [{"role": "home_welcome", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Select Starting Desktop Mode", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}}
2: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Recovery Warning Checklist on Sign-In: Add an account persistence checklist component to the sign-in screen highlighting email matching to prevent duplicate resets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Sign in with your original account to maintain pet data", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
3: [choose_path, reorder] Story Teaser Prioritization Flow Reorder: Reorder onboarding screens to highlight story narrative choices prior to path selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "story": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "show_progress": true}}
4: [home, wait_info] Estimated Generation Time Counter on Waiting Screen: Display explicit progress bars and estimated generation time counters on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "show_progress": true}}
5: [adoption, incentive] Pet Naming Encouragement Badge on Certificate: Add an official pet adoption badge component to the adoption certificate screen to encourage users to finalize naming.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Adoption Badge", "style": "playful"}]}}
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Docking System Tray Hint: Add a prominent system tray control hint text on the home introduction screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Right-click your pet or use the system tray icon anytime to manage pet settings and hide options."}}
7: [choose_path, copy] Path Selection Outcome Headline Clarification: Rewrite choose_path screen headline and body text to clearly distinguish fast preset pets from custom photo pets.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Select Ready-Made or Custom Pet", "body": "Pick an instant pre-made pet companion or upload photos to generate a unique custom companion."}}
8: [adoption, notification] Photo Processing Readiness Notification Toggle: Enable desktop readiness notifications during photo processing on the upload_photos screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"notify_when_ready": true}}
9: [home, layout] Compact Stage Layout for Waiting Screen: Switch the waiting screen layout to 'compact' to streamline visual focus during backend generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "compact"}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a pet personality selection screen during onboarding is allowed under rule 4 and does not request personal data.
Redesigning the home intro component with interactive cards is a valid onboarding redesign under rule 4.
Adding account persistence checklist text to the sign-in screen is allowed within onboarding.
Reordering/updating story screen properties while preserving all required onboarding steps is allowed.
Showing estimated generation time during a real generation wait is permitted under rule 5 and rule 4.
Adding a badge component to the adoption certificate screen preserves existing jobs and is allowed under rule 4.
Adding system tray hint text to the home intro overlay is permitted within onboarding.
Clarifying path selection text preserves both adopt and make options without breaking pricing or design rules.
Enabling readiness notifications during photo processing is explicitly allowed under rule 4.
Changing the layout of the waiting screen to compact is a valid onboarding layout change.
